result.instructions: Reference server for MCP conformance testing: every advertised capability is implemented and exercised by the official suite. Tools include echo, add, and the suite's test_* contract; resources test://static-text, test://static-binary, and the test://template/{id}/data template; four test_* prompts; logging/setLevel; completion/complete.
